scope: Bounded local workflow and three actual source-grounded artifacts, not release-wide certification or universal semantic grading

dispositions.API_parameters: Original LiteLLM data retained; local nonthinking output-limit alias normalization is intentional, documented, and live-tested at an exact 16-token stop. Invalid OpenAI top-level system is rejected.
dispositions.compaction_digest: Explicit identity of Sift count/selection inputs; not a full provider-request or output hash. Includes both output-limit fields.
dispositions.artifact_binding: Published hashes reconstruct successful native edits. Required complete source reads precede the artifact edit; snapshots preserve the actual data read.
dispositions.validators: Exact model-audit schema/filename mappings and a complete 10-line runbook command/config allowlist; parent checks actual source facts and budget relationship.
dispositions.audit_IO: Persistence errors are logged without breaking valid inference.

limit: Final read-only CLI handoff hit its bounded budget; no clean independent final PASS is claimed.
